title: The Funfest people missions' species: res/funfest/species_lists.json
description: Files 2 to 21 of ARCID_FMISSION_DATA (a/2/8/9): the species that a people mission picks the Pokémon of its people from (FesMissionPeople_LoadSpecies in fest_mission_people.c), file 2 plus the mission's variant for target 8 and file 20 for target 5, up to 0x500 bytes. tools/data/funfest_mission_data.py packs them.
